name: Whittle
description: Straight cuts are scored across the first clip one after another, each piece beyond a cut sliding away, until a small polygon slides off last and uncovers the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cuts
params.description: Number of cuts before the last piece slides away

params.name: score
params.description: Color of the score line along each cut (alpha: intensity)

params.name: shadow
params.description: Color of the shadow the lifted pieces cast
